raw_text: NE Solidarity Network — Telegram Channel. Brothers and sisters across the Northeast, the violence in Manipur is not just a Manipur problem. If ethnic cleansing is allowed to happen in one state, it sets a precedent for all of us. Naga, Mizo, Khasi, Garo — we must stand together. Relief supplies are being collected in Dimapur and Aizawl for displaced families. Truck convoy departing Kohima at 6 AM tomorrow. Medical volunteers needed urgently. The tribal communities of Manipur need our support now. Contact coordinators through the pinned message. Please verify all information before sharing — there is massive disinformation from both sides.
clean_text: Northeast solidarity network calls for collective response to Manipur violence. Relief supplies are being collected in Dimapur and Aizawl for displaced families with a truck convoy departing Kohima at 6 AM. Medical volunteers are urgently needed. The network urges all Northeast tribal communities to stand together and warns about massive disinformation from both sides. Verification of information before sharing is emphasized.
